description: Client-side script for managing Tally Migration form in ERPNext, including progress updates, error handling, document resolution, and UI rendering.

methods.name: erpnext.tally_migration.getError
methods.description: Extracts error message from a traceback string, handling multi-line tracebacks.

methods.name: erpnext.tally_migration.cleanDoc
methods.description: Recursively removes null and empty string values from a JSON object.

methods.name: erpnext.tally_migration.unresolve
methods.description: Marks a document as unresolved, moving it to the failed import log.

methods.name: erpnext.tally_migration.resolve
methods.description: Marks a document as resolved, moving it to the fixed errors log.

methods.name: erpnext.tally_migration.create_new_doc
methods.description: Resolves a document and creates a new document in the system.

methods.name: erpnext.tally_migration.get_html_rows
methods.description: Generates HTML table rows for logs, including error messages, document details, and action buttons.
